messages:
Priya: FYI Orion has a paperwork snag on the EU shipment - customs put a temporary hold on 10 reserved racks for Q4 Dedicated.
Daniel: Which reservation IDs? Need to map to customers and SLAs.
Priya: R-9981, R-9982, R-9983, R-9984, R-9985, R-9986, R-9987, R-9988, R-9989, R-9990. Partner says missing C88 annex.
Marta: Can we pull from partner buffer or a marketplace fallback? What's partner buffer in EU?
Priya: Orion reports 4 spare racks in FR-region buffer. SI partner ByteStack offered 3 racks if we sign an expedite addendum.
Daniel: Action items: (1) Evaluate technical compatibility for ByteStack racks, (2) ask Orion to release 4 buffer racks, (3) draft customer comms.
OpsBot: Shipment ORN-5521 status updated -> "customs documentation missing". Estimated additional delay: 5 days. https://orion.example/shipments/ORN-5521
Marta: Quick compatibility check: ByteStack uses same rack image but different NIC bonding. Might need a 1-2h network tweak per rack.
Priya: If ByteStack swap possible, CS prefers offering that to customers with hard SLAs. For others, offer staggered onboarding or temporary token credits.
Daniel: I'll ring Legal about the short addendum for ByteStack swap. We need a fast EULA patch for 72h ramp.
LegalBot: Flagged for review. Recommended template: "temporary hardware swap addendum (limited liability + transport acceptance)". ETA 6 hours for draft.
Marta: Ops: can we run a smoke test schedule for up to 7 racks tomorrow morning? If so, we can keep customers' rollout windows.
Priya: Yes, scheduling smoke for 03:00 UTC. I'll send partners the swap request now. Also preparing a short customer note.
OpsBot: Partner ORN-5521 docs_uploaded at 3632104458. Status: pending customs inspection.
Daniel: Good. If customs clears earlier we cancel swap. Otherwise proceed with ByteStack for priority reservations. CS to send comms after Ops confirms swap start.
Priya: Noted. Thanks team. Will update in this thread as we get bind/confirm.
